sloka: वैधव्यम् शोक संतापम् कृपणम् अकृपणा सती ।अदुह्ख उपचिता पूर्वम् वर्तयिष्यामि अनाथवत् ॥४-२०-१६॥
transliteration: vaidhavyam śoka saṁtāpam kṛpaṇam akṛpaṇā satī ।aduhkha upacitā pūrvam vartayiṣyāmi anāthavat ॥4-20-16॥

translations.english: 'To what plight will the tender Angada, who has been tended affectionately and deserves comforts, be reduced when his uncle displays anger?
